Name: More bunnies
Author: emjess
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]More bunnies, to match siamece's [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url][color=#d4d4d8] rabbits. [/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]I wanted more bunnies in my game so I quick-quick edited siamece's sprites into 3 recolours and some lop-eared rabbits (5 colours). [/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]Requires [/b][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url] (for matching rabbits and other farm animals. not strictly required.)[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]Credits[/b][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/siamece?gameId=1303]siamece[/url] - it is thanks to their amazing sprites and open terms of use that I was able to put this together![/color]
